envelope.description: Bridge review tool, Git and raw-byte subprocess execution

body.title: Bridge review tool, Git and raw-byte subprocess execution
body.summary: Integrate host leases with src/daemon/tools/shell-helper.ts and review-reachable tool subprocess paths, including runShell, runShellBytes, spawnManaged and streaming/direct spawn sites. Keep permission/provenance checks and output parsing semantics; assemble the complete review-native-spawn inventory with the CLI bridge.
acceptanceChecks: Git admission, shell/raw-byte/managed-tool commands record durable intent before host spawn and retain exact bytes, exit/error and truncation semantics.
Existing tool approval/provenance and effective abort signals survive the worker bridge; returned output is parsed in the worker.
An executable inventory refuses every unbridged review-reachable spawn/exec path, including provider binary resolution from t5; other callers are unchanged.
Real short-lived command fixtures exercise cancellation, byte bounds/backpressure, worker loss and unknown cleanup without affecting another review's leases.

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/review-worker-shell.test.ts: Git shell and raw-byte commands preserve output bounds and abort semantics through leases
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-spawn-inventory.test.ts: all review-reachable native spawn and exec paths use the host bridge
